services.desc: New to pickleball? This is your starting point. Our Intro to Pickleball class is designed specifically for complete beginners - no experience, no equipment, and no worries required. Just show up in your indoor gym shoes and our certified coaches will take care of the rest. We provide paddles, balls, and all the instruction you need to get rallying with confidence. You'll learn the basics of court positioning, scoring, serving, and the rules of the game in a fun, welcoming environment. Best of all, your $20 intro class fee applies directly toward your first Learn2Play session if you decide to keep going. services.desc: Want to improve faster? Private lessons at IPOP pair you one-on-one with one of our certified coaches for a fully personalized training session. Whether you're a complete beginner looking to build a solid foundation or an experienced player working on a specific weakness, private instruction delivers the most targeted improvement possible. Sessions are booked directly with your preferred coach and can be tailored around your goals, schedule, and current skill level.
